title: Adaptive Live Story — boundary schemas (006)
description: Shared shapes between the realtime client (narration loop + capture), the route handlers (token mint, transcript persist/review), the narration state machine, and the live-story repository. Mirrors packages/contracts/src/live-story.ts. Ownership is enforced by the repository/RLS; these shapes carry no owner_id (it is stamped server-side). No realtime audio appears anywhere (FR-025).

PlanItem.description: One teachable item the narration must cover at least once (FR-004).

PlanBeat.description: One ordered story beat condensed from the LessonScript segments (R2).

teachesItemIds.description: sourceItemIds taught in this beat; empty for a pure story/connective beat.

LessonPlan.description: Derived (not persisted) ordered plan that drives narration (R2). Reproducible from lessons.script.

StartStoryToken.description: Owner-scoped credential + grounding the browser uses to open a realtime narration session (R1/R10). The xi-api-key NEVER appears here (Constitution V); only a short-lived conversation token does.

sessionId.description: id of the opened LiveSession row, used for transcript writes.

dynamicVariables.description: Plan-derived grounding injected at startSession: lesson_summary, items_list, beats_outline, target_minutes, scenario.

SessionTurn.description: One captured utterance, corrected text, attributed and ordered (FR-021/FR-022/FR-023).

elevenTurnRef.description: Optional SDK turn ref; lets a barge-in correction upsert a teacher turn in place (R5/R6).

LiveSession.description: One narration-plus-interaction episode + its ordered turns (the durable transcript record).

scenario.description: Most recent scenario in effect; null = original setting (FR-008/FR-009).

AppendTurnRequest.description: Append one or more finalized turns to a session (incremental persistence; off the speech path; FR-027). turnIndex is assigned/validated server-side as the next index. May also update the session's scenario / mark it ended.

scenario.description: Set/overwrite the session's current scenario (latest wins).

ended.description: When true, mark the session ended (status=ended, ended_at=now).

TranscriptDTO.description: Response body for GET .../transcript — the lesson's live sessions (most recent first), each with its ordered turns (FR-024).

ClientToolContract.description: The four platform client tools the narrator agent calls (R1/R3/R4). Each handler is pure-ish glue over the narration state machine and returns a short STRING the agent uses to continue. Declared on the agent (quickstart) and implemented in lib/live-story/client-tools.ts.

advanceNarration.description: Called by the agent at the end of each beat. Returns the next instruction: next beat summary, the items still owed, the current scenario to keep, or 'conclude' once all items are covered AND the length budget is spent (R1/R3/R8).

returns.description: Human-readable next-step instruction for the agent.

markItemTaught.description: Called when the agent has taught a planned item. Adds it to the covered set (R3).

setScenario.description: Called when the agent interprets the learner as requesting a scenario change. Updates state + re-pins via sendContextualUpdate; records a scenario_change turn (R4).

concludeLesson.description: Called when the agent believes the lesson is done. REJECTED (returns the still-owed items) while any planned item is uncovered (R3); otherwise acknowledges a natural close (FR-004).
